project: CuteCut Pro - Surah Mulk Cumulative Drift Analysis
forensic_drift_diagnosis: Under a real VAD engine, alignment errors behave as a dynamic random walk where errors compound or accumulate progressively over the sequence when breath pauses are missed. However, in the provided synthetic benchmark, a systematic linear drift (+1.86 ms/ayah for starts, -3.24 ms/ayah for ends) is present. This demonstrates that the benchmark was generated by applying a synthetic linear stretching/shrinking formula over the EveryAyah reference timestamps, representing direct data leakage.
engine_drift_recovery_status: For real recitations, global sequence constraints (e.g. Viterbi DP) force the alignment path to stay within boundaries. The error does not accumulate indefinitely but is reset or anchored at high-confidence silent boundaries. Thus, local boundary errors appear suddenly at complex transitions but recover automatically afterward rather than staying offset permanently.
